info.title: Keyloop Unified Service Scheduler API
info.description:
Books multi-resource workshop appointments: each booking reserves a service bay with the required capabilities and a
technician with the required certifications for the same time slot, and never double-books either, even under concurrent requests.

Every error is an RFC 9457 problem (`application/problem+json`) with a stable `type` under
`https://api.keyloop.example/problems/` and a `traceId`. Branch on `type`, not on text:

Public reads are anonymous. Customer names, VINs and registrations are masked unless the caller has an API role. Writes
require Admin or ServiceAdvisor; appointment details require any API role. Access signs in at `/auth/login`; `/api/v1/me`
discovers the caller. Resource and policy edits, their reads and audit history require Admin.

- **401** - sign-in required (`unauthenticated`, with `loginUrl`).
- **403** - the caller has no permitted role (`forbidden`).
- **400** - the request is malformed (`validation-error`).
- **422** - the request is well-formed but breaks a business rule given current reference data (for example
  `outside-operating-hours`, `lead-time-not-met`, `no-qualified-resources`).
- **409** - the request collides with current state (`slot-unavailable`, `slot-conflict`, `invalid-state-transition`,
  `concurrency-conflict`).
- **412** - Admin edit used a stale ETag (`precondition-failed`, with `current` and `currentETag`).
- **428** - Admin edit requires `If-Match` (`precondition-required`).
- **429** - rate limited (`rate-limited`, with `Retry-After`).

The full problem catalogue is in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, section 8.7 (API contract).

get.summary: Find bookable start times for a service on a date
get.description:
Returns slot-grid start times where at least one qualified bay and one qualified technician are free for the full service duration, along with free resource counts.
Starts that a booking would be refused at now (inside the minimum lead time, which includes any start already passed, or beyond the booking horizon) are left out.
Reports `closed` on non-operating days and `no-qualified-resources` when the dealership lacks required capabilities or certifications.

parameters.name: dealershipId
parameters.description: The dealership whose bays, technicians and opening hours are used (the example is the seeded Reading dealership).

parameters.name: serviceTypeId
parameters.description: The service to fit (the example is the seeded Interim Service).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The dealership's local calendar date, exactly `yyyy-MM-dd`, from yesterday to the end of the booking horizon.

parameters.name: powertrain
parameters.description: Optional powertrain; omitted is conservatively Unknown with vehicle-aware requirements enabled.

parameters.name: manufacturer
parameters.description: Optional OEM code.

parameters.name: vehicleClass
parameters.description: Optional class; Heavy requires a heavy lift and HeavyVehicle certification.

parameters.name: needsLiveDiagnosis
parameters.description: Explicit live HV work requiring level 4 and an EV bay.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional request correlation UUID (36 characters, hyphenated). Missing, malformed or multiple values generate a new UUID; the response echoes the accepted or generated id.

200.description: The operating window and the bookable starts in ascending order with free bay and technician counts; no starts, and a reason when the day can have none.

X-Request-Id.description: The accepted or generated request correlation UUID, also recorded on the server Activity and in log scopes.

400.description: The service type id or the date is missing or malformed, or the date is outside the bookable range, or a vehicle parameter is not exactly one member name (a comma list, a repeated parameter or a number) or `needsLiveDiagnosis` is not `true`/`false` (`validation-error`, `errors` keyed `serviceTypeId`, `date`, `powertrain`, `manufacturer`, `vehicleClass` or `needsLiveDiagnosis`).

X-Request-Id.description: The accepted or generated request correlation UUID, also recorded on the server Activity and in log scopes.

X-Request-Id.description: The accepted or generated request correlation UUID, also recorded on the server Activity and in log scopes.

422.description: A vehicle-aware input (`powertrain`, `manufacturer`, `vehicleClass`, or `needsLiveDiagnosis=true`) while vehicle-aware requirements are disabled in this deployment (`vehicle-aware-requirements-disabled`, with `rejectedFields`): it is refused rather than ignored.

X-Request-Id.description: The accepted or generated request correlation UUID, also recorded on the server Activity and in log scopes.

post.description:
Reserves a qualified bay and technician for the service slot, honouring optional preferences and `Idempotency-Key` replay within 24 hours.
When vehicle-aware requirements are enabled, optional vehicle profile facts and live-diagnosis flags refine qualification and allocation rules.

parameters.name: dealershipId
parameters.description: The dealership to book at (the example is the seeded Reading dealership).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional; makes retries safe. 1 to 64 characters of letters, digits, '-' and '_' (a UUID works). The same key with the same body within 24 hours of a successful booking replays its 201 (with Idempotent-Replayed: true) and books nothing; the same key with a different body is a 422 idempotency-key-reuse. Failed bookings are not stored, so they can be retried with the same key.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional request correlation UUID (36 characters, hyphenated). Missing, malformed or multiple values generate a new UUID; the response echoes the accepted or generated id.

requestBody.description: The booking: the service and its start time, the customer and the vehicle, with an optional preferred bay, technician and notes.

201.description: Booked: the appointment with its bay, technician and local times; `Location` is its path. A replay carries `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

Location.description: The new appointment's path, /api/v1/appointments/{id} (the same id on a replay).

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present, with the value true, only when the response is the stored result of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

X-Request-Id.description: The accepted or generated request correlation UUID, also recorded on the server Activity and in log scopes.

400.description: The body or the `Idempotency-Key` is malformed (`validation-error`, `errors` keyed by JSON path such as `customer.email`, or `Idempotency-Key`).

X-Request-Id.description: The accepted or generated request correlation UUID, also recorded on the server Activity and in log scopes.
The accepted or generated request correlation UUID, also recorded on the server Activity and in log scopes.

X-Request-Id.description: The accepted or generated request correlation UUID, also recorded on the server Activity and in log scopes.

409.description: The slot is taken: every qualified bay or technician is busy (`slot-unavailable`), or the database's overlap backstop fired (`slot-conflict`, with `conflictingResource`); both carry `suggestedSlots`, the nearest bookable starts that day. Repeated requirement-policy changes answer `concurrency-conflict`: no booking committed; refresh availability and retry the booking.

X-Request-Id.description: The accepted or generated request correlation UUID, also recorded on the server Activity and in log scopes.

413.description: The request body exceeds the 64 KiB limit (framework RFC 9110 problem).

X-Request-Id.description: The accepted or generated request correlation UUID, also recorded on the server Activity and in log scopes.

422.description: A business rule refuses it: `outside-operating-hours`, `lead-time-not-met`, `beyond-booking-horizon`, `slot-not-aligned`, `no-qualified-resources`, `idempotency-key-reuse`, `vehicle-profile-conflict`, or `vehicle-aware-requirements-disabled` (`needsLiveDiagnosis` or `vehicle.profile` sent while vehicle-aware requirements are disabled, named in `rejectedFields`; refused rather than ignored). Vehicle-aware no-qualified-resources adds minimumHvLevel, requiredBrand and firedRules.

X-Request-Id.description: The accepted or generated request correlation UUID, also recorded on the server Activity and in log scopes.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying (RFC 9110 delay-seconds); the problem's retryAfterSeconds carries the same value.

X-Request-Id.description: The accepted or generated request correlation UUID, also recorded on the server Activity and in log scopes.

get.summary: List appointments for a local date range
get.description:
Returns appointments starting between `from` and `to` (inclusive, up to 62 calendar days) in the dealership's time zone, optionally filtered by status.
Callers with Admin, ServiceAdvisor, or Viewer receive full customer names, VINs, and registrations; other callers receive masked values (`ALS`, `***********123456`, and `*******`).

parameters.name: dealershipId
parameters.description: The dealership whose appointments are read (the seeded Reading dealership in the example).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First inclusive local date, exactly `yyyy-MM-dd`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last inclusive local date, exactly `yyyy-MM-dd`; on or after from, spanning at most 62 calendar dates including both bounds.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional, repeatable, case-sensitive status names: Confirmed, CheckedIn, InProgress, Completed, Cancelled, NoShow. Omit to read every status.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional request correlation UUID (36 characters, hyphenated). Missing, malformed or multiple values generate a new UUID; the response echoes the accepted or generated id.

200.description: An array of appointments ordered by start, then id, with service, bay and technician summaries and the customer name, VIN and registration (masked for callers without an API role); empty when there are no matches.

X-Request-Id.description: The accepted or generated request correlation UUID, also recorded on the server Activity and in log scopes.

400.description: Missing or malformed dates, from after to, more than 62 inclusive days, or an invalid status (`validation-error`, with `errors` keyed `from`, `to` or `status`).

AdminBayResponse.description: Full Admin bay representation. Version is PostgreSQL xmin, also returned as a strong ETag.

before.description: Previous bounded reference state, null on creation. Shape follows resourceKind.

after.description: Committed bounded reference state. Shape follows resourceKind.

AdminHistoryResponse.description: Newest first, stable ordering by timestamp and id; use nextOffset until null.

AdminPolicyResponse.description: Immutable policy state. ETag is quoted policy-{version}; old versions are retained.

AdminTechnicianResponse.description: Full Admin resource representation. Version is PostgreSQL xmin, also returned as a strong ETag.

decidedBy.description: First comparison separating the technician winner from the runner-up, or OnlyQualifiedResource.

bayDecidedBy.description: The separate deciding criterion for the service bay.

policyVersion.description: The resolved dealership policy version at booking.

minimumHvLevel.description: The resolved HV competence floor at booking.

firedRules.description: Policy rule codes in deterministic order.

reasons.description: Bounded exclusion reason codes for preferred resources that were not chosen.

preferredBayId.description: Original preferred bay hint, including one excluded by qualification or busy time.

AllocationDecision.description: The persisted explanation is a snapshot of the policy and minimum in force when allocated.

id.description: The appointment id; `GET /api/v1/appointments/{id}` reads the whole record.

status.description: Lifecycle status, including cancelled and no-show appointments.

startUtc.description: Inclusive start in UTC, for example `2026-10-13T08:00:00Z`.

startLocal.description: Start in the dealership's time zone with offset, `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm±hh:mm`, for example `2026-10-13T09:00+01:00`.

endLocal.description: End in the dealership's time zone with offset; may fall outside the requested date range.

serviceType.description: The booked service's id, code, name and duration in minutes.

bay.description: The allocated bay's id and display name.

technician.description: The allocated technician's id and display name.

customerName.description: The customer's name. Callers with an API role (Admin, ServiceAdvisor or Viewer) receive it in full; every other caller receives one upper-case initial per whitespace-separated part, from its first letter, for example `ALS` for Alice Louise Smith.

vin.description: The vehicle's 17-character VIN, upper case, for callers with an API role; every other caller receives eleven asterisks and its last six characters, for example `***********123456`.

registration.description: The vehicle's registration plate, upper case, for callers with an API role; every other caller receives it fully masked as `*******`, whatever the plate, so no character or length is revealed.

AppointmentListItemResponse.description: An appointment selected by its local start date, with its service and allocated resources.

id.description: The appointment's id; `Location` of a booking points at `/api/v1/appointments/{id}`.

dealershipId.description: The dealership whose bay and technician are reserved.

bay.description: The service bay reserved for the whole slot (chosen by the allocation policy unless a preferred free one was given).

technician.description: The technician reserved for the whole slot.

endUtc.description: End (exclusive), UTC: the start plus the service duration.

startLocal.description: Start as the dealership's local time with offset, `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm±hh:mm` (e.g. `2026-10-13T10:00+01:00`), for display.

endLocal.description: End as the dealership's local time with offset, `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm±hh:mm`, for display.

status.description: Lifecycle state: `Confirmed` when booked; `CheckedIn`, `InProgress`, `Completed`, `Cancelled` or `NoShow` later.

notes.description: Free-text notes from booking, trimmed; null when none were given.

cancellationReason.description: Why the appointment was cancelled; null unless `status` is `Cancelled`.

updatedAtUtc.description: When its status last changed, UTC (the booking time until then).

oneOf.description: Vehicle-aware decision, policy version and fired rules. Absent on legacy bookings.
Read-time review warning against recorded requirements for active appointments; omitted when clean or disabled.

AppointmentResponse.description: An appointment: one service for one vehicle, with the bay and the technician reserved for it over the same time slot.

date.description: The local calendar date asked for, in the dealership's time zone.

timeZoneId.description: The dealership's IANA time-zone id (e.g. `Europe/London`); every `…Local` value is wall-clock time there, with that zone's offset.

oneOf.description: Opening to closing time that day; null when the dealership is closed on that weekday.

durationMinutes.description: How long the service occupies one bay and one technician, in minutes.

slotGranularityMinutes.description: Start times fall on this grid, counted from the opening time.

slots.description: Bookable start times on the slot grid in ascending order, or empty when closed, fully booked, or no remaining start is still bookable now (inside the minimum lead time or beyond the booking horizon).

unavailableReason.description: Reason when no slots can exist on the requested date (`closed` or `no-qualified-resources`); otherwise null.

AvailabilityResponse.description: Feasible start times for one service on one local date at one dealership.

startUtc.description: Start (inclusive), UTC. The identity of the slot: book with this value.

endUtc.description: End (exclusive), UTC: the start plus the service duration.

startLocal.description: Start as local time with offset, `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm±hh:mm` (e.g. `2026-10-13T10:00+01:00`), for display.

freeBays.description: How many qualified bays are free for the whole slot (at least 1).

freeTechnicians.description: How many qualified technicians are free for the whole slot (at least 1).

AvailabilitySlotResponse.description: A bookable start time, with how much capacity remains at it.

id.description: The bay's id (usable as `preferredBayId` on a booking).

capabilities.description: What the bay is equipped for, in the enumeration's declared order.

isActive.description: False when the bay is out of service: it takes no new bookings, but the appointments it already holds stay listed under it.

appointments.description: Appointments overlapping that day's opening hours in every status except `Cancelled`, ordered by start.

BayScheduleResponse.description: A service bay, a lane of the board, with the appointments it hosts that day.

isActive.description: Whether this bay accepts new bookings.

BayWriteRequest.description: Complete service-bay state; taking a bay out of service preserves its appointments and history.

needsLiveDiagnosis.description: Explicit live HV working flag: requires level 4 and an EV bay when vehicle-aware requirements are enabled.

serviceTypeId.description: The service to book, from the catalogue (the example is the seeded Interim Service).

startUtc.description: Start time in UTC (`Z`, whole minutes) aligned to the dealership's operating hours and slot grid.

preferredBayId.description: Optional preferred bay ID, honoured when free and compatible with the service.

preferredTechnicianId.description: Optional preferred technician ID, honoured when free and certified.

examples: Customer reports a rattle from the front left wheel.
notes.description: Optional free text for the workshop, at most 1000 characters after trimming.

enabled.description: Whether service suggestions are enabled on this API.

imagesEnabled.description: Whether private photo uploads are available.

maxTotalImageBytes.description: Maximum combined decoded photo bytes per evaluation.

BookingTriageStatusResponse.description: Feature discovery for the booking dialog. Disabled triage leaves manual booking available.

reason.description: Reason for cancellation, 1 to 500 characters after trimming.

requiresReview.description: True: staff should review this appointment; clean appointments omit this response.

reasonCodes.description: Bounded qualification-lapse codes, in stable order; never resource names or visitor text.

CompetenceWarningResponse.description: Read-time review signal against the booking's hard requirements. Never reassigns or rewrites an appointment.

authenticated.description: Whether the API verified the caller's identity.

email.description: The verified email; null when not authenticated.

roles.description: API roles in the order Admin, ServiceAdvisor, Viewer; empty without one.

loginUrl.description: The same-origin Access login path, returning to `/`.

name.description: Full name, 1 to 120 characters after trimming.

phone.description: Phone number, 3 to 40 characters of digits, spaces and `+ ( ) -`.

opensAt.description: Opening time, `HH:mm` local; null when the dealership is closed that day.

closesAt.description: Closing time, `HH:mm` local (exclusive); null when the dealership is closed that day.

timeZoneId.description: IANA time-zone id (e.g. `Europe/London`) in which the operating hours are expressed.

operatingHours.description: Exactly seven entries, one per weekday, Monday first.

lastVisitUtc.description: The most recent booking's start UTC, across every status.

visits.description: Number of this dealership's bookings with the same case-insensitive email and VIN, across every status.

ReturningCustomerResponse.description: Intake fields from the most recent booking of a customer-and-vehicle pair; no booking free text or profile.

ReturningVehicleDetails.description: Vehicle intake fields only; no profile, provenance or allocation requirements.

id.description: The appointment's id; `GET /api/v1/appointments/{id}` has the whole record (contact details, make and model, notes).

startLocal.description: Start as the dealership's local time with offset, `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm±hh:mm` (e.g. `2026-10-13T10:00+01:00`), for display.

endLocal.description: End as the dealership's local time with offset, `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm±hh:mm`, for display.

status.description: Lifecycle state (`Confirmed`, `CheckedIn`, `InProgress`, `Completed`, or `NoShow`); cancelled appointments are excluded.

technician.description: The technician reserved for it, one of the schedule's `technicians`.

vin.description: The vehicle's 17-character VIN, upper case, for callers with an API role; every other caller receives eleven asterisks and its last six characters, for example `***********123456`.

registration.description: The vehicle's registration plate, upper case, for callers with an API role; every other caller receives it fully masked as `*******`, whatever the plate, so no character or length is revealed.

customerName.description: The customer's name. Callers with an API role (Admin, ServiceAdvisor or Viewer) receive it in full; every other caller receives one upper-case initial per whitespace-separated part, from its first letter, for example `ALS` for Alice Louise Smith.

oneOf.description: Computed review warning and bounded reason codes against recorded requirements for active appointments; omitted when clean, non-active, or unauthorized.

ScheduledAppointmentResponse.description: An appointment on the board: when it runs, what it is, who works on it, and for which vehicle and customer.

id.description: The service type's id, used when asking for availability and booking.

code.description: Stable upper-kebab identifier, unique across the catalogue (e.g. `EV-BATTERY-CHECK`).

durationMinutes.description: How long the service occupies one bay and one technician, in minutes (a multiple of 5).

requiredBayCapabilities.description: Capabilities the bay must have, all of them, in the enumeration's declared order.

requiredCertifications.description: Certifications the technician must hold, all of them, in the enumeration's declared order.

bookable.description: True when the dealership has active bays and technicians capable of performing the service under the current policy, ignoring busy time and opening hours.

ServiceTypeResponse.description: A catalogue entry: how long the service takes, what it needs, and whether the dealership in the route can perform it.

durationMinutes.description: How long the bay and the technician are reserved, in minutes.

ServiceTypeSummary.description: The booked service, as the catalogue lists it.

id.description: The technician's id (usable as `preferredTechnicianId` on a booking); appointments name it in `technician.id`.

employeeNumber.description: The dealership's employee number for the technician, unique within the dealership.

certifications.description: What the technician is certified to perform, in the enumeration's declared order.

isActive.description: False when the technician takes no new bookings; appointments made before still name them.

hvLevel.description: Vehicle-aware competence level 0..4; absent when the flag is off or the caller has no API role (the four competence fields are employee data).

hvLevelValidUntil.description: Inclusive local-date expiry; omitted when unlimited or the flag is off.

hvLevelConfirmed.description: False includes migrated levels, which still count.

TechnicianResponse.description: A technician on the dealership's roster: a lane of the board when it is viewed by technician.

employeeNumber.description: Unique within this dealership, 1..32 trimmed characters.

isActive.description: False deactivates without changing existing appointments.

hvLevel.description: HV level, zero to four; unconfirmed levels still count.

hvLevelValidUntil.description: Inclusive dealership-local expiry; null means unlimited. Required: send null explicitly.

hvLevelConfirmed.description: A person's confirmation of the recorded level.

brandSpecialisms.description: At most 16 normalized OEM codes of at most 32 characters, data only.

TechnicianWriteRequest.description: Complete technician state. Names and employee numbers are bounded reference fields, never notes.

examples: Brakes squeal, it's an EV, need it Thursday.
description.description: The issue and optional preferred date, 1 to the configured maximum (500 by default) characters after trimming.

imageIds.description: Optional photos: at most four distinct, unexpired UploadBookingTriageImage ids from this dealership, at most 8 MiB decoded in total.

TriageBookingRequest.description: A customer's untrusted booking intake description, never stored or logged.

recommendation.description: suggest, confirm or no-match. Always require a person's confirmation.

serviceConfidence.description: Clef's service confidence, distinct from a candidate's probability.

services.description: At most three bookable candidates meeting the absolute and relative probability floors, most likely first.

oneOf.description: Confidently selected local date, including a closed day, or null.
Confidently selected additional issue outside the most likely service, or null.

TriageBookingResponse.description: Service suggestions for human confirmation. This operation never books an appointment.

TriagePreferredDate.description: A concrete date in the dealership's zone. Availability still decides whether it has slots.

TriageServiceCandidate.description: A candidate from the dealership's bookable catalogue.

TriageUncoveredCategory.description: Closed UI-copy keys for problems outside the most likely service. One appointment covers one service.

category.description: Closed UI-copy key for the additional issue.

probability.description: The category's probability in Clef's answer.

confidence.description: Clef's confidence in this answer, compared with the uncovered-issue threshold.

outsideServiceTypeId.description: The most likely service type that the issue falls outside, or null if outside all bookable services.

TriageUncoveredIssue.description: Additional uncovered issue category with probability and confidence.

contentType.description: image/png, image/jpeg or image/webp. The file's signature and header must match it.

base64.description: Standard base64 of the whole file: 1 byte to 4 MiB decoded (at most 5,592,408 characters) and at most 16 megapixels.

UploadBookingTriageImageRequest.description: A PNG, JPEG or WebP image. Original filenames are never sent or stored.

imageId.description: Opaque reference for TriageBookingRequest imageIds, valid only for this dealership until expiresAt.

contentType.description: The validated type: image/png, image/jpeg or image/webp.

expiresAt.description: One hour after upload. Later evaluations treat the reference as missing; storage deletes it within about an hour more.

UploadBookingTriageImageResponse.description: A private, dealership-scoped upload reference usable for triage until expiry.

VehicleClass.description: Workshop-relevant vehicle class; Heavy adds lift and task competence requirements.

powertrain.description: Resolved powertrain; Unknown conservatively inherits concrete HV rules.

vehicleClass.description: Resolved workshop class; Unknown carries no heavy-vehicle assertion.

provenance.description: Server-assigned attribute sources and private declaration accountability.

VehicleProfile.description: Vehicle facts independent of identifiers. Unknown powertrain is conservatively treated as high voltage.

powertrain.description: Powertrain observed at intake; a concrete value requires a reason.

manufacturer.description: Normalized OEM code, maximum 32 ASCII letters/digits/hyphens.

vehicleClass.description: Car, light commercial, heavy, or Unknown.

declarationReason.description: Private audit reason, 1..500 characters after trimming, required for concrete powertrain.

conflictChoice.description: UseDecoded acknowledges a discrepancy and retains decoded values and their provenance.

VehicleProfileRequest.description: Advisor-declared facts; source, actor and reason are assigned by the server. Omission means Unknown.

oneOf.description: Optional advisor vehicle profile declaration when vehicle-aware requirements are enabled.

vin.description: Vehicle identification number: 17 characters, digits and letters other than I, O and Q (case-insensitive).

registration.description: Registration plate, 1 to 16 characters; stored upper case.

oneOf.description: Resolved facts and server-assigned provenance, present on vehicle-aware bookings.

dealership.description: The dealership, with the time zone every `…Local` value is expressed in.

date.description: The local calendar date asked for, in the dealership's time zone.

oneOf.description: Opening to closing time that day; null when the dealership is closed on that weekday, and every bay's `appointments` is then empty.

slotGranularityMinutes.description: Bookable start times fall on this grid, counted from the opening time: the natural column width of a timeline.

bays.description: Every bay of the dealership, active or not, ordered by name, each with its appointments that day.

technicians.description: Every technician of the dealership, active or not, ordered by name. Each appointment's `technician.id` is one of them.

WorkshopScheduleResponse.description: The dispatch board for one dealership on one local date, including all bays, their appointments, and all technicians.

CloudflareAccess.description: Access application JWT, validated for RS256 signature, team issuer, configured AUD and lifetime. Forwarded by Access on protected paths; never accepts unsigned edge identity or token role claims.
CloudflareAccess.name: Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion

AccessCookie.description: Hostname-scoped Access application JWT from /auth/login (Cookie Path Attribute disabled). Validated by the API on public paths. Browser sends it automatically; header takes precedence.
AccessCookie.name: CF_Authorization
